review_candidates.title: Technical Support Engineer (B2B Fintech / Payments)
review_candidates.description_excerpt: Key Responsibilities Own technical support requests from B2B merchants and payment providers in Russian and English through to resolution. Investigate complex payment issues, identify root causes and drive corrective actions beyond standard troubleshooting. Create and maintain internal Knowledge Base articles based on complex investigations. Requirements 1-2+ years of experience in B2B technical support, integration support or technical account management.
eligibility_evidence: Its platform brings together card payments, payouts and other payment methods for international customers.
You will communicate with international clients in English and Russian.
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: Requirements 1-2+ years of experience in B2B technical support, integration support or technical account management. Hands-on experience in payments at a payment gateway, bank or payment orchestration platform.
